title: Spatial coding dysfunction and network instability in the aging medial entorhinal cortex
goal: Independently reproduce and improve the original author-reported decoder on unchanged data, inputs, splits, metric and complete support. Figure5i RF track-position decoding: all61 original sessions (34young,27aged), >10 spatialcell99 cells, non-single-map and optimal SilN==2 eligibility, source downsampling and ten within-session test partitions. Score mean cosine angular error by fold, average ten folds equally per session and retain separate age summaries. Spike-shuffle vectors are compulsory controls, never higher-is-better targets.
